learning_objective: 🎯 Learn like a scientist! Discover how psychologists conduct research, collect data, test theories, and validate their findings scientifically.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Psychological research aims to achieve five goals: Description (what is happening), Prediction (when will it happen), Explanation (why is it happening), Control (modifying behavior), and Application (solving problems).

Experiments establish cause-and-effect relationships. Researchers manipulate an Independent Variable (cause) to see its effect on a Dependent Variable (effect), while keeping all other conditions constant.
Systematically watching behavior. It can be Naturalistic (observing in real-life settings without interfering) or Controlled (observing in a lab).
Determines if a relationship exists between two variables (e.g., study time and exam scores). It can be positive, negative, or zero. Remember: Correlation does NOT mean causation!
Standardized tools used to measure individual differences (like intelligence or personality). A good test must be Reliable (consistent results) and Valid (measures what it claims to measure).

fun_activity.title: 👁️ The Naturalist
fun_activity.instructions: Go to a park or a busy room. Pick one person (discreetly) and write down exactly what they do for 3 minutes without adding your own opinions or interpretations. This is naturalistic observation!

exam_tips: 📌 Be ready to identify the Independent Variable (IV) and Dependent Variable (DV) from a given scenario.
📌 Clearly explain the difference between Reliability (consistency) and Validity (accuracy).
📌 Always mention ethical guidelines (informed consent, confidentiality, debriefing) when discussing psychological research.
quick_recap: ⭐ A hypothesis is a tentative and testable statement about the relationship between two or more variables.
⭐ The control group in an experiment does not receive the experimental treatment.
⭐ Case studies provide in-depth information about a single individual but cannot be easily generalized to everyone.
